[accounts]
active = "readyrule"
records = [
    { id = "readyrule", name = "readyrule", harness = "claude", auth = "managed" },
    { id = "makers", name = "makers", harness = "claude", auth = "managed" },
]

expect.stderr:
readyrule: not a picker candidate: managed, rides the shared ~/.claude slot
  makers: not launchable: account 'makers' is managed and not the active ~/.claude account (active: readyrule). Per-spawn selection for a non-active account needs its own config dir: register it with a config_dir (e.g. --config-dir ~/.claude-makers, a full second login) so the worker gets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The setup-token env lane bills the wrong account and is deliberately not used.
pick: no launchable candidate among readyrule, makers: only an account with its own config dir can be pinned to a worker. Register one with `fno config accounts register <id> --config-dir <path>` (a full second login in its own dir)
